name: Jaymart Group Holdings Public Company Limited
summary: Jaymart Group Holdings Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the wholesale and retail of mobile phones, accessories, and gadgets in Thailand. The company operates through four segments: Trading Business, Debt Collection Business, Rental Business, and Others.
